primary_endpoint: Percentage change from baseline in ALT levels at week 16.
efficacy_outcome: Week-16 ALT change was −25.5%, −27.7%, and −45.8% with saroglitazar 1, 2, and 4 mg, respectively, versus +3.4% with placebo (P < 0.001 for all).
safety_signal: Saroglitazar was well tolerated; mean weight gain was 1.5 kg with 4 mg versus 0.3 kg with placebo (P = 0.27).
